items.title: Elon Musk Raises $3 Billion For Tunneling Startup The Boring Company
items.summary: The funding round was led by the United Arab Emirates and valued The Boring Company at $23 billion.  The UAE had previously awarded The Boring Company a contract to build one of its signature tunnels in Dubai.  Other investors in this most recent round of fundraising include top venture capital firms such as Sequoia Capital, a16z, Vy Capital and Human Capital.
